# CHD-3.2 index build log
Generated by `handbook/chd32/gen-index.py` from `BOOK-chd32.yaml`, the rendered part PDFs, rendered HTML sources, and source inputs. The generator resolves section-relative folios from PDF footer text and refuses missing PDF pages, missing rendered register captions, missing disposition ids, or discontinuous part leaves.
- Deliverable: `handbook/chd32-1-index.pdf` - Source: `handbook/chd32-1-index.html` - Generator: `handbook/chd32/gen-index.py` - Index pages: 22 (section 0 sheets 1–22; leaf 1–22) - Part sheets consumed: 64 (sections 1–16; leaves 1–68 after the corrected leaf pass is reflected in the part PDFs) - Figures resolved from rendered captions: 40 - Tables resolved from rendered captions: 132 - Disposition ids checked: F-001..F-019, R31-001..R31-030, D-001..D-038 (87/87) - CHD-3.1 map rows: all 11 sheets plus named figures - Placeholder scan: zero `TBD`, `TODO`, `lorem`, or `see above` - Render: `render.sh` exit 0, fit reports 101.2 mm free on page 1 (the index uses explicit page divs and is measured per page) - `check.py`: the checker was run on each page split from the canonical 22-page index; all 22 passed A4, black/white, and font checks. The checker’s one-page mode cannot accept the intentionally multi-sheet index as a single input. - Tiles: `handbook/tiles-chd32/index/` and per-page checker tiles under `handbook/tiles-chd32/index-single/`
